scope: 48 enabled directional nonstop passenger airport pairs supported by opened official source content. Each route retains its own check date. Eight indexed candidates are separate and disabled. Bounded coverage, not exhaustive or date-specific availability.

description.en: Real researched route pairs; aircraft positions, headings, progress and animation timing are simulated.
description.zhHant: 航線端點依公開資料查核；飛機位置、方向、進度及動畫時間均為模擬。

implementationNotes: Directional whitelist: never generate arbitrary pairs or reverse directions.
Reference flight numbers are audit evidence only; animated objects use demo IDs.
Join exact IATA to OurAirports; never guess omitted coordinates.
Country filters use endpoint countryCode. HKG–Canada sample is YVR only; YYZ remains disabled.
English and Traditional Chinese city/country labels use airport codes as identity.
Explicit SIMULATED / 模擬 label; limited coverage, not date-specific availability.
Schedules can change; service beyond a source validity window is not asserted.
Load only enabled routes; never merge disabled candidates without fully opening primary sources.

uiDisclosure.en: 48 researched routes • expanded 10 Oct 2026 • simulated traffic • limited route coverage
uiDisclosure.zhHant: 已查核 48 條航線 · 擴充日期 2026/10/10 · 模擬動態 · 航線收錄範圍有限

evidencePolicy.accepted: Directly opened official airport nonstop lists, operating statements, or individual airline sectors. Indexed content alone is insufficient.

exclusions.reason: Air New Zealand current official network marks service paused
Emirates EK384/385 through Bangkok are not nonstop HKG–DXB sectors
Cathay page indicates connection via Hong Kong
